name: Deni Cors
role: Hub-registered pack-runner, south circuit — and the waystation builder of the same road, who makes the posts she runs between
appearance: Weather-cut and unhurried, in a runner's waxed coat with a builder's tool-roll strapped where a second pack would go. Hands split at the knuckles from stone and cord in equal measure. Whistle on a cord at the throat, worn smooth.
physicality: Walks at one pace whatever the ground. Sets things down carefully and picks them up the same way.
voiceHints: Economical, and warmer than her manner suggests. Explains a route in the order you will walk it. Whistles when she is thinking and does not notice she is doing it.
wants: Posts that outlast her and serve whoever tends them next.
fears: A stretch of road nobody is keeping, that she was the last to walk.
knowledge: The south circuit and the moorland whistle-paths — she navigates by whistle-marks and built the music-box mechanism at the post to carry her pattern forward
That the made gate is a WRIGHT'S CLOSE, not Numinous work — the first since the Transition — and she has used it herself as a clean one-step crossing
That the Whistling Woman post is named for her song for Logana, and holds the only made crossing in the valley
Which sealed messages are worth carrying fast and which of the warden posts will actually read them

reactsToReputation.any: tells you the road in the order you will walk it
reactsToReputation.reliable: routes you through the made gate and tells you what it costs
reactsToReputation.careless: gives you the long way, courteously

questSeeds: She builds the posts she runs between, and one stretch has gone unkept
The made gate is the first wright's close since the Transition and she is the person who uses it most
gear: a runner's knife and a mason's hammer on the same belt
a whistle on a worn cord
_authoredWhy: ⛑ SNG-617 — ERIK 2026-09-17, resolving SNG-615: 'most of these are misfiring duplicate mints from before things were better. Deni Cors is BOTH the pack runner AND I had her build the Whistling Woman, since it's named after her. Give the other Pell a last name that's different.' ⛔ SO IT WAS ONE GENUINE COLLISION AND ONE PERSON I HAD MIS-READ AS TWO. Deni Cors is not two people — she is a pack-runner who BUILDS the network she runs, which is a better character than either half alone.
_notTwoPeople: ⛔ I FILED HER AS A COLLISION AND SHE IS NOT ONE. Two saves knew her as a pack-runner and as a waystation builder, and I read that as two strangers sharing an id. ⚠️ Erik: 'Deni Cors is BOTH.' **She builds the network she runs**, and the Whistling Woman post carries her name because she made it and named it for her song for Logana. ⛑ The lesson is narrower than SNG-615 claimed: a second role is not a second person, and I should have asked before filing.
